title: Annoying Boss Punch Game
description: The ultimate office stress buster! Tired of boring meetings and overtime work? Punch, kick, and throw eggs or water balloons at your annoying boss to unleash your inner frustration!
controls: Left Click to punch/combo. Arrow Keys to move. Spacebar for heavy punch. E/R for special props. Esc to pause.

title: Nitro Speed 2 Underground
description: Get ready for intense underground street racing! Drive fast cars, dodge obstacles, and beat your rivals in Nitro Speed 2.
controls: Use Arrow Keys or WASD to drive. Press Space for Handbrake.

title: Archer: Dungeon Hero
description: Embark on an epic adventure as a master archer! Fight through dangerous dungeons, defeat monsters, and upgrade your skills.
controls: Use WASD or Arrow keys to move. Aim and shoot automatically or using Mouse.

title: MergeDuel.io
description: Merge weapons, upgrade your gear, and battle against other players in this fast-paced online duel arena!
controls: Drag and drop to merge items. Click to interact and battle.

title: Fireboy and Watergirl 7: and Friends
description: Work together with Fireboy, Watergirl, and their friends to solve tricky elemental puzzles, collect gems, and overcome traps in the temples!
controls: WASD to control Watergirl. Arrow keys to control Fireboy.

title: Farm Vs Zombies
description: Protect your farm from incoming waves of hungry zombies! Deploy upgrades, hold the defense line, and save the crops in this action-packed shooter.
controls: Mouse or Touch to aim and shoot. Keyboard shortcuts to activate power-ups.

title: Fury Tanks
description: Drive powerful armored tanks, blast through enemy lines, and upgrade your war machine in action-packed tank battles!
controls: WASD or Arrow keys to move, Mouse to aim and shoot.

title: Pool Duel
description: Test your billiards skills in Pool Duel! Aim your cue, adjust your power, and pocket all the balls to defeat your opponent in this realistic 8-ball pool challenge.
controls: Mouse / Touch to aim the cue, drag and release to adjust power and shot.
